mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id AS vid, event_type, status, retry_count, lease_recovery_count, confirm_writeback_count, created_at, next_retry_at, sending_at, sent_at, CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR last_error = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS last_error_present FROM video_status_outbox WHERE status = 3 AND id > #{afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id AS vid, event_type, status, retry_count, lease_recovery_count, confirm_writeback_count, created_at, next_retry_at, sending_at, sent_at, CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR last_error = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS last_error_present FROM video_status_outbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 3

SELECT id, event_id, aggregate_id AS vid, event_type, status, retry_count, lease_recovery_count, confirm_writeback_count, created_at, next_retry_at, sending_at, sent_at, CASE WHEN last_error IS NULL OR last_error = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS last_error_present FROM video_status_outbox WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 3 FOR UPDATE
